    StartersPâté toastsChicken liver pâté, brandy, thyme, hot rye toast.Say the word at the door first.How to make it400g chicken livers30g butter, for searing2 shallots, chopped3 sprigs of thyme, leaves picked40ml brandy150g soft butter50g clarified butter, melted8 slices of rye breadsalt and pepper, to tasteTrim the livers and sear in butter for 2 minutes a side until still pink.Add the shallots and thyme, then the brandy, and let it bubble off.Blitz with the soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish.Pour over the clarified butter and chill for 4 hours.Toast the rye and serve with the pâté.Caspar's cheese strawsTwisted puff pastry, cheddar, parmesan, cayenne.Johnny has views on this.How to make it2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beaten80g aged cheddar, grated30g parmesan, grated1 pinch cayenne pepperBrush one sheet of pastry with egg and scatter with cheddar, parmesan and cayenne.Lay the other sheet on top and press down. Cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each.Bake at 220°C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.MainsLeo's Irish stewLamb neck chops, potatoes, carrots, onions, stout.Danny Boy on the gramophone while it braises.How to make it1.2kg lamb neck chops2 brown onions, sliced3 carrots, in chunks800g potatoes, in thick slices375ml stout300ml beef stock2 tbsp chopped parsley2 tbsp olive oilBrown the lamb in batches in oil.Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots and potatoes.Pour over the stout and stock, cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours until tender.Finish with parsley.SweetsWhiskey bread puddingBrioche, raisins soaked in the good Irish, custard.Short at the bill?
